name: Mining
description: Extract ores from formations that were minding their business.

name: Woodcutting
description: Fell trees. They have opinions about this.

name: Fishing
description: Catch fish. The fish are furious.

name: Cooking
description: Turn raw food into HP restoration items.

name: Smithing
description: Turn bars into equipment at a forge.

name: Negotiation
description: Diplomacy with sentient creatures. They give resources willingly, with conditions.

name: Gleaning
description: Absorb magical residue from dying-world artefacts. Nobody knows what it does yet.

name: Fabrication
description: Improvised engineering. Combine what the world provides in ways that shouldn't work.

name: Infusion
description: Combine gleaned residue with crafted materials. Results vary wildly.

name: Chronicle
description: Document the dying world. Your records grant buffs. High level: you rewrite reality.

name: Spectral Work
description: Harvest and shape ghost energy. Synergises with the ghost system.

name: Brokerage
description: Economic power through the auction house. No AFK mode — you have to actually be there.

name: Convergence
description: The merge skill. Auto-merges at ~40% of manual speed while AFK at a Convergence node.
